beats.headline: Three hundred and thirty-three outcomes
beats.text: On the way to the brig, Zhang's new cape flutters behind him: white, with the black, blue, red and yellow circles of an archery target. It was his prize in the celestial box. Unactivated, it gives fifteen per cent to every stat and a level 10 Dodge skill, taking his Dodge from eleven to fourteen. Once an hour it offers Roll the Dice: 333 outcomes, most great, a few epic such as Death Ray, and 66 bad, none fatal, all temporary, the worst Summon the God Who Hates You Most. After 19 spins he may pick. He will not use it unless he must.

beats.headline: Thrown on the table
beats.text: In the next race, Zhang says, he will kill Torpedo, their octopus mount, so the system kills Li Na, and him with her. Carl tells him that will not work any more. She is killing people, Zhang says, and she has stopped talking to him. He meets Carl's eyes, rips the target cape off and throws it on the table. He wishes he had died in the temple. Carl stares at the cape. The AI gave it to Zhang after he survived the battle inside Club Vanquisher, a fight he went to only because they needed his help.

beats.headline: Back on, with purpose
beats.text: Elle, Zhang and Tran pull back from the table with a new plan. Zhang grabs his target cape and pulls it back on, standing straight and tall and with purpose. The three of them are going back to the safe room to try to reach Li Na and tell her what they mean to do. Carl whispers good luck to Elle, and she returns it, looking over her shoulder at Donut.
